title: The big players must show their cards
hook: Is there any way to see what the largest traders are actually doing?
metaphor: Once a week the biggest players at the table have to turn their hands face up. You get to look, but only at last Tuesday's hand.
body: Large traders must report their positions to a US regulator.
The report shows whether they are betting on prices up or down.
When almost everyone is on one side, that side gets crowded.
Crowded bets can unwind fast when the news turns.

live.template: Big traders are currently {gold_side} on gold, sitting near the {gold_pctile}th percentile of the last three years.

caveat: The data is published Friday for positions held the previous Tuesday. It is context, never a trigger.
